title: A copy is not asked to decide things only its original can
goal: Picking a copy of a component shows a Layout section offering to change how that copy arranges and pads its contents, but anything typed there is quietly thrown away the next time the original changes. A copy should either not offer the setting or should keep what you typed.
notes: Found on 2026-09-04 while auditing the container-hug work. ComponentInstances refill copies the original main group layout onto every copy (group.layout = main.group?.layout), so a copy padding edit is overwritten by the next syncComponentInstances. Same family as the lost-typing bug fixed on 2026-09-04. Simplest answer: EditorState.arrangingGroupID excludes an instance root, the way handles already do.
acceptance: The Layout section is not offered on a copy, or what is typed into it survives the original changing
A copy still shows its own knobs and its own position and size
Picking the original still offers the whole Layout section
